scientific_integrity: Proof uses published Mori cone and weak Fano theorem, cubic-surface intersection theory, and standard contraction results; exact symbolic checker is supplementary. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Five general complex points; not a statement for special configurations or positive characteristic. Numerical curve-class decomposition and weak Fano property are previously established. The new conclusion is the exact geometric eleven-curve exceptional set and eleven ordinary double points.
title: Eleven nodal contractions in the anticanonical model of a five-point blow-up of \\(\\mathbb P^1\\times\\mathbb P^2\\)
